title: Workflow Monitoring and Metrics knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Workflow Monitoring and Metrics?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Useful workflow metrics include success rate, failures, queue time, execution time, and cost/consumption; track trends to prioritize improvements.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: Useful workflow metrics include success rate, failures, queue time, execution time, and cost/consumption; track trends to prioritize improvements.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of workflow monitoring and metrics: Useful workflow metrics include success rate, failures, queue time, execution time, and cost/consumption; track trends to prioritize improvements. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: Make the workflow contract explicit: identify the event, job runner, inputs, command/action, output, and failure signal. Keep steps small and review the permissions and source of every action.
questions.explanation: Workflow success rates: Make the workflow contract explicit: identify the event, job runner, inputs, command/action, output, and failure signal. Keep steps small and review the permissions and source of every action. Apply the guidance to the actual event, runner, permissions, or artifact boundary and test the relevant case.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to workflow monitoring and metrics?
options: Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: Useful workflow metrics include success rate, failures, queue time, execution time, and cost/consumption; track trends to prioritize improvements. A syntax check alone cannot prove remote execution, permissions, or deployment behavior.
